items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Mr. Janky had a lot of them working for him, didn't he? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah. I think he sure did.

ctx.x: Yeah, I don't know. Kids start that. Little, uh, Sash Moe. Little, little, little, little. Guy, them fellas work out there for W.C. Kyle's a coal yard. Used to drive them dump carts, coal carts, you know? Uh huh. Used to land, let them have a mule, you know? They have a mule. Put in the parade for the Zulus, you know? Uh huh.
And Mr. Janky had a lot of them working for him, didn't he?
Oh yeah. I think he sure did. He used to toast them.
